description: MB-2 INTERSECT golden (docs/design/multi-body.md §Decisions-3 / §MB-2): the `boolean` feature's `intersect` operation between two independently-built bodies. Five features mirror the union golden: (1) a 20x20 mm square on the XY origin datum at x,y in [0,20]; (2) extrude add 20 mm up -> body A, a 20x20x20 cube; (3) a second 20x20 mm square at x in [10,30] (overlapping A in x[10,20], SAME y,z); (4) extrude add 20 mm up merge=FALSE -> body B, a second 20x20x20 cube; (5) a `boolean` feature, operation `intersect`, target=extrude A / tool=extrude B. intersect keeps ONLY the common volume of A and B: the result takes over the target's identity slot and the tool body is removed, so the part ends with a SINGLE body. Because A covers x[0,20] and B covers x[10,30] with IDENTICAL y,z in [0,20], A intersect B = EXACTLY the overlap slab x[10,20] -- a clean 10x20x20 box, ONE connected solid (verified: OCCT common + clean gives 6 faces / 12 edges / 1 shell). Locks the MB-2 intersect path end to end: OCCT common (BRepAlgoAPI_Common) + clean(), the single-connected-solid-per-body invariant (shells=1), operand replacement, and -- via the parametrized gates -- byte-identical GLB across an interpreter restart + STEP round-trip re-measure. An intersect with NO overlap (empty common) is a `boolean_empty` error, covered in test_boolean.py (not a golden -- there is no body to measure).
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug). Body A: a 20x20 square, corners (0,0)-(20,20) mm on the XY datum (normal +Z at z=0), extrude add 20 mm up -> cube A spanning x,y in [0,20], z in [0,20]. Body B: a 20x20 square at corners (10,0)-(30,20) mm on the same XY datum, extrude add 20 mm up (merge=false) -> cube B spanning x in [10,30], y in [0,20], z in [0,20]. A intersect B = the common block where BOTH bodies exist: x in [max(0,10), min(20,30)] = [10,20], y in [0,20], z in [0,20] -- a 10x20x20 region.

volume = |A intersect B| = 10*20*20 = 4000 mm^3 exactly (the overlap slab x[10,20] x y[0,20] x z[0,20]). Measured deviation vs analytic: ~9e-13 mm^3 (a couple of ulp at the 4e3 scale from the GProp integration of the common result).

surface_area = the result is a 10x20x20 rectangular box, so area = 2*(10*20 + 10*20 + 20*20) = 2*(200 + 200 + 400) = 2*800 = 1600 mm^2. The common region's boundary is the box's six faces (the x=10 and x=20 cut planes plus the shared y,z faces). Measured deviation: ~2e-13 mm^2.

centroid = (15, 10, 10) mm: the centroid of the 10x20x20 box spanning x[10,20], y[0,20], z[0,20] is its geometric center ((10+20)/2, (0+20)/2, (0+20)/2) = (15, 10, 10). Measured deviation: x within ~2e-15 mm, y and z exactly 0.
bounding_box = [10,0,0]..[20,20,20]: the overlap slab spans x[10,20], y[0,20], z[0,20]. An exact prism, so all six bounds are EXACT (measured deviation 0.0).

topology = 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 SHELL: the result is a single connected box. shells=1 is the load-bearing MB-2 assertion -- the intersect is ONE connected solid (the single-connected-solid-per-body invariant, §Decisions-3); an intersect with two separate contact regions would be a `boolean_disjoint` error, and an empty overlap a `boolean_empty` error. clean() (ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain) merges any coplanar face fragments, so the box reduces to its canonical 6 faces / 12 edges. Euler-Poincare cross-check: V - E + F = 8 - 12 + 6 = 2 = 2*(1-0), a valid closed genus-0 manifold solid.

mesh (linear 0.1 mm / angular 0.1 rad, faceted per-face normals, no vertex sharing across faces -- the box-golden convention): each of the 6 planar quad faces -> 4 vertices / 2 triangles; 6 faces = 24 vertices / 12 triangles.

GLB byte size is deliberately NOT pinned here: it is asserted deterministic (byte-identical) by the runner within one kernel version, but pinning the absolute size would break on every glTF-writer upgrade without geometric meaning.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill: never copy a bound blindly). A intersect B for two axis-aligned overlapping prisms (Solid.extrude bodies, OCCT BRepAlgoAPI_Common + ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain clean) is geometrically an exact 10x20x20 box. Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-07-18, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, planegcs 0.8.0): volume ~9.1e-13 mm^3, surface_area ~2.3e-13 mm^2, centroid x ~1.8e-15 mm (y/z exactly 0.0), all six bounding-box bounds exactly 0.0. Documented ceiling 1e-9 (matching the sibling boolean-union / boolean-subtract / multibody goldens) is ~1100x the observed worst case (~9e-13, volume), headroom for platform FP variation across OCCT builds and the STEP round-trip re-measure, while staying 5 orders of magnitude tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m -> 1e-4 mm at model scale). The solver contributes zero error by construction (both squares shape-pinned; planegcs returns the drawn positions bitwise; solved == input). Loosening this further requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
